mgs.title: Keeping recurring production moving across a remote studio
mgs.summary: Four years coordinating recurring review and publishing for an international studio releasing three times a week, plus Patreon.
mgs.context: Michael Ghelfi Studios produces RPG music and soundscapes with a small international team working remotely in English. As Studio Manager, I connected the studio's pipeline across editorial review, video post-production, multi-channel publishing, and website operations for three weekly public releases plus regular Patreon deliverables.
items: Managed a small team of writers through review, continuous feedback, quality control, and editorial standardization.
Edited and published the studio's YouTube releases and Patreon packages.
Administered the WordPress site, managed plugins, and maintained custom mu-plugins.
Coordinated external automation tools, publishing pipelines, and studio social channels.
mgs.decisions: Determined editorial themes, video publishing selection, thumbnail A/B testing, structured ambiance/SFX playlists, and generative-AI artwork concepts.
steps: Assembled the full album video from supplied music
mgs.reach: The published video recorded 936,714 views as of 15 September 2026 — reach of the complete release, including the composer's music and the studio's distribution.
mgs.also: I adapted the studio's commissioned black-and-white mark with a metallic-gold treatment for featured releases. The original mark was designed by another creator.

mapa.title: Turning client-facing spreadsheets into an interactive explanation
mapa.summary: MapaFinanceiro — an interactive web simulator built with coding agents, used by a consórcio sales team to replace confusing spreadsheets.
mapa.context: A consórcio sales team previously relied on complex spreadsheets during consultations with prospective clients. Clients found formulas difficult to follow in conversation, and testing different timeframes or down payments required tedious manual adjustments.
items: Real-time interactive inputs for income, target property value, available down payment, and target timeframe.
Dynamic comparison between property appreciation (7.0% p.a.) and investment returns (6.2% p.a.) over 30 years.
Detailed bidding strategy simulation: quota raffle, fixed bid (44 installments), limited bid (88 installments), and free bid.
Side-by-side comparative matrix contrasting pure savings, traditional bank mortgages, and consórcio bidding.
mapa.decisions: Focused the experience on clear conversations rather than raw calculation tables: changing the target timeframe immediately updates the required contribution and scenario narrative.
steps: Starting Position: Captures income, property goal, and available capital
The Cost of Waiting: Visualizes property inflation outpacing regular savings
Target Timing: Dynamically calculates monthly savings needed for 3 vs 5 years
Bidding Mechanics: Simulates out-of-pocket vs embedded bids (up to 50% deduction)
Decision Matrix: Transparent comparison with mortgage interest and terms
mapa.credit: Built for active use by a consórcio consultation team.
mapa.reach: Deployed live on Vercel; eliminates spreadsheet friction during client intake without requiring backend infrastructure.
mapa.linkLabel: explore Mapa da Bella live application
mapa.also: All simulation outputs reflect stated assumptions. They serve as explanatory sales tools, not formal credit approvals, guarantees, or financial advice.

points: Separates AI execution from change adoption through distinct consultation and review phases.
